title: 听力挑战 · 咖啡馆点餐

rounds.speaker: 服务员
rounds.line: Good morning! Are you ready to order now?
rounds.lineCn: 早上好!您现在准备点餐了吗?

grammar.name: 现在进行时表状态
grammar.note: Are you ready 用 be 动词加形容词表示当前状态;现在进行时也可表示正在进行的动作。

options.text: Yes, I would like a large latte.
options.feedback: 明确表达点餐意愿,直接回应服务员。

options.text: No, I was late this morning.
options.feedback: 说的是今天早上的迟到,没有回应点餐问题。
只评论咖啡香味,没有点餐。

rounds.speaker: 服务员
rounds.line: What are you having for your drink today?

grammar.name: 现在进行时表将来安排
grammar.note: What are you having 用进行时询问将要进行的动作,口语中常表计划。

options.text: I am having an iced tea, please.
options.feedback: 用现在进行时回应点单,时态与问句一致。
过去时说的是昨天喝的,不是现在的选择。

rounds.speaker: 服务员
rounds.line: Would you like anything to eat as well?
rounds.lineCn: 还需要来点什么吃的吗?

grammar.name: 进行时与意愿表达
grammar.note: Would you like 询问意愿,可结合 would like 结构作答。

options.text: Yes, I would like a cheese sandwich.
options.feedback: 回应食物询问,点单明确完整。

options.text: I am eating my lunch now.
options.feedback: 正在吃午饭与点餐场景矛盾,也没有点单。

options.text: The menu is on the table.
options.feedback: 说的是菜单位置,没有回应询问。
